o: The trio investigates the mysterious murder of Sazz Pataki, Charles' stunt double, whose death raises questions about whether Sazz or Charles was the intended victim. The Arconia residents find themselves entangled in Hollywood drama as a studio adapts their podcast into a movie, leading to new faces and on-set chaos. As the action ramps up, the amateur sleuths return to New York, diving into…

eps.t: Once Upon a Time in the West
eps.o: Charles, Oliver & Mabel are whisked to Los Angeles where a legendary film studio intends to adapt their podcast. However, Hollywood's glitz is overshadowed by a stunning clue about Charles' stunt double & friend Sazz Pataki.
Mabel & Oliver begin investigating Arconia's West Tower and get trapped inside an ominous game. Meanwhile, Charles is visited by two individuals from his complex past.
Charles, Oliver & Mabel begrudgingly pair off with new investigators... actors Eugene Levy, Zach Galifianakis & Eva Longoria.
Charles, Oliver & Mabel delve into the particular universe of stunt people. They encounter a suspect with an incredibly... familiar... face.
The trio face off against a collection of individuals who deceive, manipulate, and threaten as second nature - a Hollywood cast & crew.
A documentary film is made by The Brothers Sisters.
Terrified by a threat inside the Arconia, the trio race out of the city. A member of Charles' family provides refuge and yet, this safe house proves to be anything but.
Charles, Oliver & Mabel combine forces with the film actors in an epic showdown against the Westies. You can't handle the truth.
Seeking a critical clue, Charles, Oliver & Mabel must infiltrate a film set to get the real "background" on why Sazz was killed.
The final answers to our season are revealed - but not before the trio faces mortal danger and an Arconia wedding.
